meta_description: Painting Decorating Services in Leeds. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full decorating. Free quotes, reliable local painters.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert painting and decorating work done right, on time, and at a fair price across Leeds.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: From interior room makeovers to exterior property restoration, we handle every decorating job with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Full room repaints, feature walls, woodwork finishing, and wallpaper hanging. We prepare surfaces properly and use quality finishes that last.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's outside. We paint fascias, soffits, doors, gates, and rendered walls using weather-resistant products.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Expert wallpaper selection and hanging, including feature walls and textured finishes. We handle awkward corners and match patterns perfectly.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, architraves, doors, and built-in furniture painted to a professional finish. Every detail matters to us.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Shop fronts, offices, and commercial spaces painted on schedule and within budget. Minimal disruption to your business.

services.title: Damp & Damage Repairs Before Decorating
services.desc: We identify and address underlying damp, cracks, or damage before painting, ensuring your new finish lasts years longer.

about_pullquote: Every room matters. We treat your home like we'd treat our own.
about_para_1: Painting Decorating Services has been transforming homes and businesses across Leeds for over 15 years. We started because we were frustrated by rushed work and cowboys charging over the odds. Today, we're known locally for attention to detail, reliable timekeeping, and honest pricing. Our team has the skills to handle everything from feature walls to full exterior overhauls.
about_para_2: We turn up when we say we will, prepare surfaces properly, and use quality paints and materials that stand the test of time. Our customers come back to us because we listen to what they want, offer practical advice, and leave their home spotless when we're done. That's earned us a solid reputation across Harehills and beyond.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our lounge. Lads were tidy, professional, and didn't fuss about moving furniture. Finished in the timeframe they quoted and the finish is perfect. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had our hallway and stairs wallpapered. The pattern match is flawless and they even sorted out a couple of damp patches before starting. Fair price and no mess left behind. Very happy.
reviews.author: Claire W.

reviews.text: Exterior paint job on the fascias and soffits was excellent. Survived the winter storms no problem and still looks fresh. Will call them again when the kitchen needs doing.
reviews.author: David M.
